e.title: **「可行」是精确的，不是近似的**：Python 包 **rank-preserving-calibration**——**把分类器输出的类别概率校准到已知总体边际，同时不打乱类内排序**（**Dykstra 交替投影／ADMM／稀疏二次规划三种解法**）；**⭐ 它逐字论证「交点永不空」**（**因此失败只可能是条件数或迭代预算问题，而不可能是不可行**）；**⭐ 并逐字点名一个更差的求解器**（**OSQP 在 N=400 时返回 592 处排序违例，**却报告「已运行」**）；**⭐ 论文与实验代码同在一仓**
e.title_en: Feasibility is exact and not approximate: the Python package rank-preserving-calibration adjusts classifier class probabilities to known population marginals without scrambling the ordering of individuals inside each class, offering Dykstra alternating projections, ADMM and a sparse quadratic program, arguing verbatim that the intersection is never empty so a failure can only ever be a conditioning or iteration-budget problem, naming a solver that is measurably worse because it returned hundreds of rank violations while reporting that it ran, and keeping the manuscript and its experiment code in the same repository as the package.
e.title_hk: **「可行」是精確的，不是近似的**：Python 套件 **rank-preserving-calibration**——**把分類器輸出的類別機率校準到已知總體邊際，同時不打亂類內排序**（**Dykstra 交替投影／ADMM／稀疏二次規劃三種解法**）；**⭐ 它逐字論證「交點永不空」**（**因此失敗只可能是條件數或迭代預算問題，而不可能是不可行**）；**⭐ 並逐字點名一個更差的求解器**（**OSQP 在 N=400 時返回 592 處排序違例，**卻回報「已運行」**）；**⭐ 論文與實驗程式碼同在一倉**
e.summary: **rank-preserving-calibration**（仓库 `finite-sample/rank-preserving-calibration`，PyPI 发行名 `rank_preserving_calibration` 0.9.0）**是一个把分类器输出的类概率**校准到已知总体边际**的 Python 包**：**做法是把概率投影到两个凸集的交集上**——**① 行单纯形**（**每行和为 1 且非负**）、**② 等渗列边际**（**在类内按原分数排序后取值非降，且每列和等于使用者给定的目标**）；**逐字自述目标人群为**「**Survey statisticians and machine learning practitioners**」。**本条目属于本轮主题**「登记与出处」**，**且它把「可核查」做到了少见的地步**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 结论被测试核对而不是被声明**——**逐字**「**That claim is checked against an independent convex solver in the test suite rather than asserted.**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字论证可行性是精确的**——**逐字**「**Feasibility is exact, not approximate.**」**，**并给出理由**（**每行和为 1 故总和固定为 N，**目标必须满足 `sum(M) == N`；**满足时常矩阵 `Q[i, j] = M[j] / N` 就是一个解，**故交集**永不空**）**，**据此断定失败只可能是**条件数或迭代预算**问题**，**而当目标不可行时**「**the solver warns, then raises `CalibrationError`**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字点名一个更差的工具并给出数字**——**逐字**「**OSQP, also first-order, is *worse* than Dykstra here, returning 592 rank violations at `N=400` while reporting that it ran.**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 它画出自己的上限**——**逐字**「**Above roughly `N = 6400` the exact solve becomes expensive again**」**并给出替代做法**（**放宽约束而不是等着**）；**⭐⭐ ⑤ 论文与包同仓**（`ms/` 下含 `ms.tex`、`ms.pdf`、`multiclass.bib`、`kl_theory.tex` **与三个实验脚本及其输出表**）。**⚠️ 本次未安装、未运行、未复现其任何计时**。
e.summary_hk: **rank-preserving-calibration**（倉庫 `finite-sample/rank-preserving-calibration`，PyPI 發行名 `rank_preserving_calibration` 0.9.0）**是一個把分類器輸出的類別機率**校準到已知總體邊際**的 Python 套件**：**做法是把機率投影到兩個凸集的交集上**——**① 行單純形**、**② 等滲列邊際**；**逐字自述目標人群為**「**Survey statisticians and machine learning practitioners**」。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「登記與出處」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 結論被測試核對而不是被聲明**——**逐字**「**That claim is checked against an independent convex solver in the test suite rather than asserted.**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字論證可行性是精確的**——**逐字**「**Feasibility is exact, not approximate.**」**，**並給出理由**（**常矩陣 `Q[i, j] = M[j] / N` 就是一個解，**故交集**永不空**）**，**據此斷定失敗只可能是**條件數或迭代預算**問題**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字點名一個更差的工具並給出數字**——**逐字**「**OSQP, also first-order, is *worse* than Dykstra here, returning 592 rank violations at `N=400` while reporting that it ran.**」；**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 它畫出自己的上限**——**逐字**「**Above roughly `N = 6400` the exact solve becomes expensive again**」；**⭐⭐ ⑤ 論文與套件同倉**（`ms/` 下含 `ms.tex`、`ms.pdf`、`multiclass.bib`、`kl_theory.tex` **與三個實驗腳本及其輸出表**）。**⚠️ 本次未安裝、未運行、未復現其任何計時**。
e.summary_en: **rank-preserving-calibration**, housed at `finite-sample/rank-preserving-calibration` with the distribution name spelled with underscores and released on PyPI as version 0.9.0, **is a Python package that calibrates classifier class probabilities to known population marginals without scrambling the ordering of individuals within each class**: it projects probabilities onto the intersection of two convex sets, the row simplex where each row sums to one and is non-negative, and isotonic column marginals where within each class values are non-decreasing once instances are sorted by their original scores and each column sums to a user-supplied target; its own description names survey statisticians and machine learning practitioners as its audience. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance, and the package takes checkability unusually far**: its central claim is checked against an independent convex solver in the test suite rather than asserted; it argues verbatim that feasibility is exact rather than approximate, because every row summing to one fixes the grand total and the constant matrix satisfies all three constraint sets, so the intersection is never empty and a failure can only be a conditioning or iteration-budget problem, and when the targets are infeasible the solver warns and then raises an explicit error; it names a measurably worse tool with a number, reporting that another first-order solver returned 592 rank violations at N=400 while reporting that it ran; it draws its own limit by stating that above roughly six thousand four hundred rows the exact solve becomes expensive again and telling the reader to relax the constraint rather than wait; and it keeps the manuscript, its bibliography and its experiment scripts with their output tables in the same repository as the package. **Nothing was installed, run or timed this round.**
e.body:
**rank-preserving-calibration**（仓库 `finite-sample/rank-preserving-calibration`；**PyPI 发行名** `rank_preserving_calibration`，**`pyproject.toml` 里 `name` 逐字为** `rank_preserving_calibration`，**版本** `0.9.0`）**是一个把分类器输出的类概率校准到已知总体边际的 Python 包**，**逐字自述的使用者为**「**Survey statisticians and machine learning practitioners**」。**本次实测**：**许可 MIT**（**`license = "MIT"` 且** `license-files = ["LICENSE"]`**）**、**`requires-python = ">=3.12"`**、**作者** `Gaurav Sood`、**关键词逐字为** `calibration`、`machine learning`、`multiclass`、`isotonic`、`dykstra`、`admm`；**运行依赖** `numpy>=1.20`、`scipy>=1.10`、**`clarabel>=0.9`**，**可选** `performance = numba>=0.56`；**构建后端逐字为** `uv_build>=0.12.5,<0.13`；**GitHub 提交时间为 2026-09-08**（**本次经该仓库的提交 Atom 流实测**）；**仓库文件清单经 tarball 枚举为 88 条路径**。本条目属于本轮主题**「登记与出处：让别人查得到，也让每个数回得去」**；**本词条认为它是本轮四条里把「可核查」做得最彻底的一条**。

**可核实信息（均 README、`pyproject.toml`、CI 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它说明问题出在哪，而不是只说解法**——**README 逐字**：**「**Simple post-hoc methods that apply separate logit shifts or raking to each class can scramble the ranking of individuals within a class when there are three or more classes.**」**，**并逐字给出两个约束集**：**① 行单纯形**「**each row sums to one and all entries are non-negative**」；**② 等渗列边际**「**within each class, values are non-decreasing when instances are sorted by their original scores for that class, and the sum of each column equals a user-supplied target**」。**⭐ 即**它先说清**朴素做法为什么会坏**（**类内排序被打乱**）**，**再说自己把概率投到哪两个集合的交上**——**这与本站 [[insurance-calibration]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[mapie]]、[[fortuna]]、[[puncc]] 一类「预测不确定性与校准」条目讨论的是同一类问题，但取向不同**（**这里管的是「边际对不上」，不是「覆盖率」**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 核心结论被测试核对，而不是被声明**——**逐字**：**「**The algorithm uses Dykstra’s alternating projection method in Euclidean geometry. When the specified column totals are feasible, the procedure returns a matrix that preserves cross-person discrimination within each class, matches the desired totals, and remains a valid probability distribution for each instance. That claim is checked against an independent convex solver in the test suite rather than asserted.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一句**：**它把「我的算法有这些性质」**降级成「**这些性质被另一个求解器核对过**」**——**⭐ 而**这一句同时也把边界说清了**：**被核对的是**性质**，**不是**「更快」或「更好用」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字论证「可行」是精确的**——**README 逐字为一个小节标题**：**「**Feasibility is exact, not approximate.**」**，**随后**：**「**Every row sums to one, so the grand total is fixed at `N` and the targets must satisfy `sum(M) == N`. When they do, the intersection is *never* empty — the constant matrix `Q[i, j] = M[j] / N` satisfies all three constraint sets — so a failure is a conditioning or iteration-budget problem, never infeasibility. When they do not, no matrix satisfies both constraint sets and there is no "closest point satisfying both" to return: the solver warns, then raises `CalibrationError`.**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 它给出**存在性证明的构造****（**常矩阵就是一个可行解**）——**因此把「求解失败」的归因范围**收窄成一个可检验的判断**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 它拒绝「最近点」这种听起来合理的兜底**——**逐字**「**there is no "closest point satisfying both" to return**」**，**即**不可行时**不返回一个看起来像答案的东西**，**而是**先警告、**再抛错**；**③ ⭐⭐ 它顺手给出用法纠正**——**README 逐字建议先按 `M = M * N / M.sum()` 归一再调用**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 它逐字点名一个更差的工具，并给出数字**——**逐字**：**「**A sparse QP alone is not enough — OSQP, also first-order, is *worse* than Dykstra here, returning 592 rank violations at `N=400` while reporting that it ran.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮第二处最值得抄的写法**：**它把「另一个求解器不行」写成了**可复现的具体形状**（**同一问题、同一规模、一个具体数字、以及「它自己说它跑成功了」**）**——**⭐ 即**不是「我们不推荐 X」，**而是「**X 在这个规模下返回了 592 处排序违例**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 它画出自己的上限，并给出替代做法**——**逐字**：**「**Above roughly `N = 6400` the exact solve becomes expensive again**, since interior-point factorisation cost grows steeply. Relax the constraint rather than wait:**」**，**随后给出** epsilon-slack **的用法**（**逐字说明**「**which permits adjacent within-class decreases of at most `eps` and is handled exactly, by lowering the isotonic bound rather than by penalising violations**」**）**。**⭐ 即**它的边界不是「可能会慢」，**而是**一个量级**，**外加一条**「**不要等，放宽约束**」**的建议**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 三种解法的取舍被写成一张表和一组实测计时**——README 给出三行表（`qp` **默认、稀疏二次规划、内点法，逐字**「**always**」；`dykstra` **仅依赖 numpy 的参考实现，逐字**「**useful if you cannot take the solver dependency**」；`admm` **逐字**「**when you want primal/dual residual traces**」**）**，**并逐字说明三者**「**are mathematically equivalent — they solve the same convex problem, and the test suite asserts they agree**」**；**接着给出 `J=4` 下的实测计时表**（**N=25：0.03 s vs 0.002 s；N=50：9.6 s vs 0.004 s；N=100：10.5 s vs 0.01 s；N=400：dykstra**「**does not converge in 60,000 iterations**」**而 qp 为 0.12 s；N=1600：1.4 s；N=6400：50 s**）**，**并逐字给出原因**「**the two constraint sets meet at a shallow angle, which is exactly where first-order methods crawl and where an interior-point method is unaffected**」。**⭐ 即**默认值不是偏好，**而是**被计时表支撑的选择**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑦ 论文、实验与包在同一个仓库里**——**文件清单实测**：`ms/` 下有 `ms.tex`、`ms.pdf`、`multiclass.bib`、`kl_theory.tex`、`Makefile`，**以及** `ms/experiments/` **下的** `synthetic_experiment.py`、`real_data_experiment.py`、`run_experiments.py` **与输出** `synthetic_results.csv`、`real_data_results.csv`、`synthetic_table.tex`、`real_data_table.tex`、`brier_vs_rank.pdf`、`synthetic_tradeoff.pdf`。**⭐ 即**「**主张—实验—产物**」**三样在同一次提交历史里**（**⭐ 与本词条项目第 340 轮「写下每个数字从哪来」和第 350 轮「源与生成物」是同一类做法**）。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 它自己的 CI 也被审计**——`.github/workflows/` **实测含** `ci.yml`、`docs.yml`、`release.yml`、`dependabot-auto-merge.yml`、`adjacent_repo_recommender.yaml`，**并且根目录另有一个** `.github/zizmor.yml`（**zizmor 是审计 GitHub Actions 工作流安全性的工具**；**⚠️ 本词条未读该文件内容，故不主张它具体开了哪些规则**）。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 登记与引用的常规件齐全**——`CITATION.cff`、`LICENSE`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`.pre-commit-config.yaml`、`uv.lock`、`py.typed`、**以及一个** `.copier-answers.yml`（**即仓库由 copier 模板生成，并把模板答案记在仓库里**）；**README 顶部徽章逐字给出** CI、PyPI 版本、文档站（GitHub Pages）、**PyPI 下载量（进 pepy.tech）**、**Python 3.12+** 与 **MIT**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 测试是可数的十六个文件**——**文件清单实测** `tests/` 下含 `test_mathematical_guarantees.py`、`test_property_based.py`、`test_audit_regressions.py`、`test_core_algorithms.py`、`test_qp_solver.py`、`test_nearly_isotonic.py`、`test_ovr_isotonic.py`、`test_kl_calibration.py`、`test_soft_calibration.py`、`test_two_stage.py`、`test_ties_and_edge_cases.py`、`test_performance.py`、`test_analysis.py`、`test_utilities.py`、`test_...` **等共 16 个**；**其中**「**数学保证**」「**性质测试**」「**审计回归**」**三个命名本身就是在声明测试的类型**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 登记层面的一个小不一致（如实记录）**：**`pyproject.toml` 里的发行名写作** `rank_preserving_calibration`（**下划线**）**，**而同一文件 `[project.urls]` 里的仓库地址写作** `rank-preserving-calibration`（**连字符**）**；**PyPI 元数据的** `project_urls` **则指向**下划线**形式**。**⭐ 本词条实测发现**：**连字符形式是该仓库的**规范名**（**tarball 解出的目录为** `rank-preserving-calibration-main`**）**，**下划线形式**会被重定向**；**⭐ 由此产生一个可复现的检索现象**：**用 GitHub 搜索的** `repo:` **限定符写下划线形式时**，**该仓库**并不出现**（**因为它只在规范名下被索引**）**——**⭐ 本词条据此记入纪律：**当 `repo:` 检索为空时，**必须**用 raw／codeload 再探一次**，**不能据检索为空断定仓库不存在**。**⭐ ⑫ 另一处时间事实**：**PyPI 上 0.9.0 的上传时间是 2026-07-31**（**本次实测**），**而仓库提交时间是 2026-09-08**——**即**仓库在发版之后仍在推进**，**发布版本落后于仓库**；**⭐ 故本条的窗口依据是**仓库提交**，**而不是发布日**。**⭐ ⑬ 与池内条目的关系**：**本条与 [[insurance-calibration]]、[[insurance-conformal]]、[[mapie]]、[[puncc]]、[[fortuna]] 讨论的是相邻问题**（**校准与不确定性**），**但它处理的是**分类概率的边际校准与类内保序**，**并明确区分了「校准」与「保序」两件事**；**其「论文与实验同仓」的做法与本站在 [[credibility-gated-xai]]、[[midr]]、[[va-valuation-shap]] 一类可解释性条目里记录的做法同形**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[insurance-calibration]]、[[mapie]] 应当并读**——**它给的是「一个模型输出的概率在交给下游之前，能不能既对上已知总体又不动个次序」这一问题的完整样本**（**含存在性论证、三种解法计时、以及一条不可行时**宁可报错也不给最近点**的规则**）。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有安装该包、没有运行任何一次校准、没有复现任何一行计时**（**未 `pip install`、未调用 `calibrate()`、未跑 `tests/`、未打开文档站或任何示例 notebook**），**故不主张**任何解法按所述工作、不主张任何计时数字、不主张其数学性质成立。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何算法源码**——**本次只读了** README **全文**、`pyproject.toml`、**仓库文件清单与 CI 文件名**，**故不主张** Dykstra／ADMM／QP 三条路径的具体实现、`CalibrationError` 的触发条件、`nearly` 参数的语义细节与 `max_iters` 的默认值。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未读其论文**（`ms/ms.tex` **与** `ms.pdf` **本次未打开**），**故不主张**其中任何实验结果、也不主张 README 里那句「**被独立凸求解器核对**」的实际核对方式（**未读** `tests/` **下任何文件**）。**④ ⚠️ 未核实计时表**（**未在任何机器上跑过，故 0.03 s／9.6 s／592 处违例等数字均为转述**）；**未核实**「**OSQP 返回 592 处排序违例**」**这一比较是否在同版本、同设置下做出**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** `clarabel` **的许可与体量**（**README 逐字写**「**Apache-2.0, ~2.5 MB**」**，**本次只转述**）。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实** PyPI 上下载量徽章所依赖的第三方统计服务当前是否可读；**未核实** GitHub Pages 文档站是否可打开。**⑦ ⚠️ `.github/zizmor.yml` 本次只看到文件存在**，**未读其内容**，**故不主张**它审计了哪些规则。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实作者背景**、**未核实**该包是否被任何生产系统使用；**⚠️ `Development Status :: 4 - Beta` 是该包自述的分类**。**⑨ ⚠️ 许可为 MIT（`pyproject.toml` 字段与** `license-files` **指向的** `LICENSE` **文件均在，**未读正文**）。**⑩ ⚠️ 仓库提交 2026-09-08 在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「论文、实验脚本与输出表同在一仓」并配一个**审计自己 CI 的配置文件**这一形态，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑫ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用时，把原文里的 ASCII 引号（**`"closest point satisfying both"` **一处）按原样保留为双引号**，**其余 ASCII 撇号一律写作 ’**——**以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改）**。

**rank-preserving-calibration**（倉庫 `finite-sample/rank-preserving-calibration`；**PyPI 發行名** `rank_preserving_calibration`，**版本** `0.9.0`）**是一個把分類器輸出的類別機率校準到已知總體邊際的 Python 套件**，**逐字自述的使用者為**「**Survey statisticians and machine learning practitioners**」。**本次實測**：**許可 MIT**、**`requires-python = ">=3.12"`**、**作者** `Gaurav Sood`、**運行依賴** `numpy>=1.20`、`scipy>=1.10`、`clarabel>=0.9`，**可選** `performance = numba>=0.56`；**構建後端逐字為** `uv_build>=0.12.5,<0.13`；**GitHub 提交時間為 2026-09-08**（**經提交 Atom 流實測**）；**文件清單經 tarball 列舉為 88 條路徑**。本條目屬於本輪主題**「登記與出處」**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、`pyproject.toml`、CI 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它說明問題出在哪**——**逐字**「**Simple post-hoc methods that apply separate logit shifts or raking to each class can scramble the ranking of individuals within a class when there are three or more classes.**」**，**並逐字給出兩個約束集**（**行單純形**／**等滲列邊際**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 核心結論被測試核對，而不是被聲明**——**逐字**：**「**The algorithm uses Dykstra’s alternating projection method in Euclidean geometry. When the specified column totals are feasible, the procedure returns a matrix that preserves cross-person discrimination within each class, matches the desired totals, and remains a valid probability distribution for each instance. That claim is checked against an independent convex solver in the test suite rather than asserted.**」**。**⭐ 即**它把「我的演算法有這些性質」**降級成「**這些性質被另一個求解器核對過**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它逐字論證「可行」是精確的**——**逐字**：**「**Feasibility is exact, not approximate.**」**，**隨後**：**「**Every row sums to one, so the grand total is fixed at `N` and the targets must satisfy `sum(M) == N`. When they do, the intersection is *never* empty — the constant matrix `Q[i, j] = M[j] / N` satisfies all three constraint sets — so a failure is a conditioning or iteration-budget problem, never infeasibility. When they do not, no matrix satisfies both constraint sets and there is no "closest point satisfying both" to return: the solver warns, then raises `CalibrationError`.**」**。**⭐ 三處值得記**：**① 它給出**存在性證明的構造****；**② 它拒絕「最近點」這種兜底**（**不可行時先警告、再拋錯**）；**③ 它順手給出用法糾正**（**逐字建議先按 `M = M * N / M.sum()` 歸一**）。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 它逐字點名一個更差的工具並給出數字**——**逐字**：**「**OSQP, also first-order, is *worse* than Dykstra here, returning 592 rank violations at `N=400` while reporting that it ran.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 它畫出自己的上限**——**逐字**：**「**Above roughly `N = 6400` the exact solve becomes expensive again**, since interior-point factorisation cost grows steeply. Relax the constraint rather than wait:**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 三種解法的取捨被寫成一張表和一组實測計時**（`qp` 預設、`dykstra` 僅依賴 numpy、`admm` 可取 primal／dual 殘差軌跡；**並逐字說明三者數學等價且測試斷言它們一致**），**另逐字給出原因**「**the two constraint sets meet at a shallow angle**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑦ 論文、實驗與套件在同一個倉庫裡**——`ms/` 下有 `ms.tex`、`ms.pdf`、`multiclass.bib`、`kl_theory.tex`，**以及** `ms/experiments/` **下的三個實驗腳本與輸出** `synthetic_results.csv`、`real_data_results.csv`、`synthetic_table.tex`、`real_data_table.tex`、`brier_vs_rank.pdf`、`synthetic_tradeoff.pdf`。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 它自己的 CI 也被審計**——`.github/workflows/` 含 `ci.yml`、`docs.yml`、`release.yml`、`dependabot-auto-merge.yml`、`adjacent_repo_recommender.yaml`，**根目錄另有** `.github/zizmor.yml`。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 登記與引用的常規件齊全**——`CITATION.cff`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`.pre-commit-config.yaml`、`uv.lock`、`py.typed`、`.copier-answers.yml`。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 測試是可數的十六個檔案**，**其中**「**數學保證**」「**性質測試**」「**審計回歸**」**三個命名本身就在聲明測試的類型**。**⭐⭐ ⑪ 登記層面的一個小不一致（如實記錄）**：**發行名寫作**下劃線**，**而** `[project.urls]` **與 README 徽章寫作**連字符**；**⭐ 本次實測發現連字符形式是規範名**（**tarball 解出的目錄為** `rank-preserving-calibration-main`**）**，**而**用 `repo:` **限定符寫下劃線形式時該倉庫不出現**——**⭐ 紀律：`repo:` 檢索為空時必須用 raw／codeload 再探一次**。**⭐ ⑫ 時間事實**：**PyPI 上 0.9.0 上傳於 2026-07-31**，**而倉庫提交為 2026-09-08**——**發布落後於倉庫**，**故本條的窗口依據是倉庫提交**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[insurance-calibration]]、[[mapie]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是「模型輸出的機率在交給下游之前，能不能既對上已知總體又不動個次序」這一問題的完整樣本**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有安裝該套件、沒有運行任何一次校準、沒有復現任何一行計時**，**故不主張**任何解法按所述工作、不主張任何計時數字、不主張其數學性質成立。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何演算法原始碼**——**本次只讀了** README **全文**、`pyproject.toml`、**文件清單與 CI 檔名**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未讀其論文**（`ms/ms.tex` **與** `ms.pdf` **未打開**），**故不主張**其中任何實驗結果，**也未讀** `tests/` **下任何檔案**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實計時表**（**未在任何機器上跑過，故 0.03 s／9.6 s／592 處違例等數字均為轉述**）。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實** `clarabel` **的許可與體量**（**README 逐字寫**「**Apache-2.0, ~2.5 MB**」**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**下載量徽章所依賴的第三方統計服務與 GitHub Pages 文件站。**⑦ ⚠️** `.github/zizmor.yml` **本次只看到檔案存在，未讀內容**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核實作者背景與實際使用情況**。**⑨ ⚠️ 許可為 MIT，未讀正文**。**⑩ ⚠️ 倉庫提交 2026-09-08 在解凍窗口之內**，**故本條不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但「論文、實驗腳本與輸出表同在一倉」並配一個**審計自己 CI 的設定檔**這一形態，此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑪ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。 **⑫ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用時，原文裡的雙引號按原樣保留**，**其餘 ASCII 撇號一律寫作 ’**——**以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（引文內容未改）**。

**rank-preserving-calibration**, housed at `finite-sample/rank-preserving-calibration`, with the distribution name written with underscores and **version 0.9.0**, **is a Python package that calibrates classifier class probabilities to known population marginals**, naming survey statisticians and machine learning practitioners as its audience. **Measured this round**: **licence MIT**, with a licence file declared alongside it; **requires Python 3.12 or later**; author Gaurav Sood; keywords calibration, machine learning, multiclass, isotonic, Dykstra and ADMM; runtime dependencies on numpy, scipy and clarabel, with an optional performance extra pulling in numba; a uv-based build backend; a **GitHub commit date of 2026-09-08**, measured through the repository commit feed; and a file listing of 88 paths enumerated from a tarball. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registration and provenance.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the project metadata, the CI configuration and the file listing**: **first, it explains where the problem comes from rather than only describing its fix**, verbatim, that simple post-hoc methods applying separate logit shifts or raking to each class can scramble the ranking of individuals within a class when there are three or more classes, and then states the two constraint sets: the row simplex, where each row sums to one and all entries are non-negative, and isotonic column marginals, where within each class values are non-decreasing once instances are sorted by their original scores and each column sums to a user-supplied target. **Second, its central claim is checked rather than asserted**, verbatim: the procedure returns a matrix that preserves cross-person discrimination within each class, matches the desired totals and remains a valid probability distribution for each instance, **and that claim is checked against an independent convex solver in the test suite rather than asserted**. **The claim is demoted from a property the package has to a property another solver verified, and the same sentence states what was checked: the property, not speed and not usability.** **Third, it argues verbatim that feasibility is exact and not approximate**: because every row sums to one the grand total is fixed, so the targets must sum to the row count; when they do, the intersection is never empty, since the constant matrix that gives each entry its column target divided by the row count satisfies all three constraint sets, so a failure is a conditioning or iteration-budget problem and never infeasibility; and when they do not, no matrix satisfies both constraint sets and there is no closest point satisfying both to return, so the solver warns and then raises an explicit calibration error. **Three things are worth recording**: it supplies a constructive existence argument, which narrows the attribution of any failure into a testable judgement; it refuses the plausible-sounding fallback of returning a nearest point, choosing instead to warn and then raise; and it adds a usage correction, telling the reader to rescale the targets first. **Fourth, it names a measurably worse tool with numbers**, verbatim, that a sparse quadratic program alone is not enough, since another first-order solver is worse than Dykstra here, returning 592 rank violations at four hundred rows **while reporting that it ran**. **The rejection is written as a reproducible shape: same problem, same size, one specific number, and the fact that the tool itself claimed success.** **Fifth, it draws its own limit and gives the alternative**, verbatim, that above roughly six thousand four hundred rows the exact solve becomes expensive again because interior-point factorisation cost grows steeply, and that one should relax the constraint rather than wait, followed by the epsilon-slack usage whose effect is described verbatim as handled exactly by lowering the isotonic bound rather than by penalising violations. **The boundary is an order of magnitude rather than a vague warning about slowness.** **Sixth, the tradeoff between three solvers is written as a table plus measured timings**: a default sparse quadratic program described as usable always, a numpy-only reference implementation described as useful when the solver dependency cannot be taken, and an augmented Lagrangian variant described as useful when primal and dual residual traces are wanted, with the note that the three are mathematically equivalent and that the test suite asserts they agree; the timings then show the default winning by orders of magnitude at fifty and one hundred rows, the reference implementation failing to converge within sixty thousand iterations at four hundred rows while the default takes a fraction of a second, and the reason given verbatim being that the two constraint sets meet at a shallow angle, which is where first-order methods crawl. **Seventh, the paper, its experiments and the package share one repository**: the file listing shows a manuscript directory containing the LaTeX source, a built PDF, a bibliography and a separate theory document, plus three experiment scripts and their outputs, including two result tables in LaTeX, two CSV result files and two PDF figures. **Eighth, even its own CI is audited**, with five workflows including one whose name suggests recommending adjacent repositories, and a separate configuration file for a tool that audits the security of workflow definitions, **whose contents this entry did not read**. **Ninth, the registration and citation furniture is all present**: a citation file, a changelog, a pre-commit configuration, a lock file, a typing marker, and a template answers file recording that the repository was generated from a project template; the badges at the top of the README cover continuous integration, the published version, a documentation site, download counts through a third-party service, the Python version floor and the licence. **Tenth, the tests are a countable sixteen files**, and three of the names, mathematical guarantees, property based and audit regressions, are themselves declarations about what kind of testing is being done. **Eleventh, one small inconsistency in registration is recorded honestly**: the distribution name is written with underscores while the repository URLs in the same metadata file and in the README badges are written with hyphens, and the registry metadata points at the underscore form; **this round found the hyphenated form to be the canonical repository name**, with the underscore form redirecting, **which produces a reproducible search artefact: asking the GitHub search API for the underscore form returns nothing, because the repository is indexed only under its canonical name. The discipline recorded from this is that an empty repository-qualified search must be re-probed through raw or tarball access before concluding that a repository does not exist.** **Twelfth, one more timing fact**: the release on the package index was uploaded on 2026-07-31 while the repository was committed to on 2026-09-08, so the repository runs ahead of the release and the window evidence for this entry is the commit, not the upload. **Thirteenth, relative to existing entries**: `[[insurance-calibration]]`, `[[insurance-conformal]]`, `[[mapie]]`, `[[puncc]]` and `[[fortuna]]` cover neighbouring questions of calibration and uncertainty, while this package handles marginal calibration of class probabilities together with within-class order preservation, and it is explicit that calibration and order preservation are two different things; keeping a manuscript, its experiment scripts and their outputs in one repository matches what the `[[credibility-gated-xai]]` and `[[midr]]` entries record about reproducible explainability work.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[insurance-calibration]] and [[mapie]]**, because **it is a complete sample of one question, whether a model probability can be made to match a known population total before it goes downstream without reordering anyone**, including an existence argument, timings for three solvers, and the rule that an infeasible target produces an error rather than a nearest point.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed, no calibration was run and no timing was reproduced** — nothing was downloaded, no function was called, the test suite was not run and neither the documentation site nor any example notebook was opened — **so no solver is claimed to work as described, no timing is claimed, and none of the stated mathematical properties is claimed to hold**. **Second, no algorithm source was read**: only the full README, the project metadata, the file listing and the CI file names were read, **so nothing is claimed about the actual implementations of the three paths, the exact trigger for the calibration error, the semantics of the nearly-isotonic options or the default iteration budget; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the manuscript was not read** — neither the LaTeX source nor the built PDF was opened — **so none of its experimental results is claimed, and no file under the tests directory was read, so the way that independent-solver check is actually performed is not claimed either**. **Fourth, the timing table was not verified on any machine, so every figure quoted here, including the seconds and the count of rank violations, is a relay rather than a measurement, and whether the comparison against the other solver was made at the same version and settings was not checked. Fifth, the licence and size of the extra solver dependency were not verified**, only relayed. **Sixth, whether the third-party download-count service and the documentation site are currently reachable was not checked. Seventh, the workflow-auditing configuration file was only observed to exist, not read, so which rules it enables is not claimed. Eighth, the author background and any production use were not verified, and a beta development-status classifier is the package own description of itself. Ninth, the licence is MIT by field and by a licence file that was not read. Tenth, the commit of 2026-09-08 is inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed here; however, the shape of keeping a manuscript, its experiment scripts and their outputs in one repository alongside a configuration that audits its own continuous integration had no counterpart in the pool. Eleventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11. Twelfth, quotation convention: double quotation marks appearing inside quoted text are preserved as they appeared, while ASCII apostrophes are rendered as curved apostrophes so that this entry contains no ASCII single quote, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged.**
